mumbai.note: 2026 is the legacy scenario label, not a common observation year. Inputs combine different periods, geographic footprints and statistics; undated inputs remain unverified. Observed means attributed to observations in the repository, not independently verified here. No baseline has been scientifically calibrated.

inputs.label: Temperature reference anchor
inputs.metric: Reported monthly mean maximum air temperature (°C)
inputs.locator: April / Santacruz row claimed; page and station identifier not recorded
inputs.note: Reported climatological normal; original table/value not verified. Used only as a numeric demo anchor, not an observed 2026 city temperature.

inputs.label: PM2.5 reference anchor
inputs.metric: Reported PM2.5 concentration (µg/m³); exact averaging period unrecorded
inputs.sourceTitle: Climate Trends & Respirer Living Sciences — Five Years of the National Clean Air Programme (January 2024)
inputs.note: 2024 is the report year. The underlying measurement year, averaging period and station aggregation are not established by the stored excerpt.

inputs.label: Tree canopy
inputs.metric: Forest/tree-cover area divided by municipal area; not a verified canopy metric
inputs.sourceTitle: FSI India State of Forest Report 2023 — Table 2.1 Urban Forest Cover by City
inputs.locator: Table 2.1 claimed; locator and definitions unverified
inputs.derivation: Stored calculation: 110.84 km² / 603 km² × 100 ≈ 18.4%. Source numerator and denominator require review.
inputs.note: Repository attribution only; source text, exact value, metric, period and geographic match have not been independently verified.

inputs.label: Built-up area
inputs.metric: Remote-sensing built-up fraction (%)
inputs.footprint: 654.20 km² study area as attributed; not demonstrated to match simulator bbox
inputs.sourceTitle: Kavathekar, Tripathy & Chettri (2025) — Land use land cover change and urban heat island effect study of Mumbai metropolitan region using remote-sensing data, International Journal of Geology
inputs.derivation: Stored calculation: 299.63 / 654.20 × 100 ≈ 45.8%; study text and classification require review.
inputs.note: Repository attribution only; source text, exact value, metric, period and geographic match have not been independently verified.

inputs.label: Water area
inputs.metric: km²; extent/season unverified
inputs.note: Unavailable. No citable total water-area value for the simulator bbox is recorded. Water effects are omitted, never imputed as zero.

inputs.label: Vehicles index
inputs.period: January 2022 numerator; Bangalore comparison year unverified
inputs.metric: Registered-vehicle count rescaled to Bangalore = 100
inputs.sourceTitle: Maharashtra Economic Survey 2022 — Statistical Appendix, Table on Motor Vehicles
inputs.locator: Economic Survey statistical appendix; exact table/page unrecorded
inputs.derivation: Stored calculation: 4.213 million / approximately 12 million × 100 ≈ 35. Different cities/years and denominator are unverified.
inputs.note: Repository attribution only; source text, exact value, metric, period and geographic match have not been independently verified.

inputs.label: Population context
inputs.metric: Municipal census population, rounded to millions
inputs.footprint: MCGM municipal corporation; not a verified match to simulator bbox
inputs.sourceTitle: Census of India 2011 — Primary Census Abstract, Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation area
inputs.locator: Primary Census Abstract; exact row unrecorded
inputs.note: Reported census count, not a 2026 population estimate. Municipal and metropolitan footprints differ; the stored value has not been independently checked.

inputs.metric: Reported annual PM2.5 mean (µg/m³); estimation method unverified

inputs.note: 2024 is the publication year. Secondary reporting does not establish the input observation period, averaging method or equivalence to a citywide observed annual mean.

inputs.label: Tree canopy
inputs.metric: Reported forest-cover percentage, used as a canopy proxy
inputs.sourceTitle: India State of Forest Report 2023, Forest Survey of India
inputs.note: Forest cover and tree canopy are not interchangeable definitions. The source table/value and canopy applicability remain unverified.

inputs.metric: Remote-sensing built-up fraction (%), rounded
inputs.footprint: Chennai Metropolitan Area study landscape, as attributed
inputs.sourceTitle: Monitoring Spatio-Temporal Dynamics in Chennai Metropolitan Area, India — MDPI Entropy
inputs.derivation: Stored attribution gives 70.35%, rounded to 70%; study area and source passage not verified.
inputs.note: Repository attribution only; source text, exact value, metric, period and geographic match have not been independently verified.

inputs.label: Water area
inputs.period: Mixed dates; 2021 mentioned for marsh extent
inputs.metric: Approximate sum of named water-body areas (km²)
inputs.footprint: CMA bbox claimed; common extent/season not established
inputs.sourceTitle: Sum of named water bodies within CMA bbox — individual Wikipedia entries and CPCB/TWAD data
inputs.derivation: Stored approximation sums lakes, marsh, rivers/canals and other areas to about 36 km². It includes estimated terms and is not a verbatim source measurement.
inputs.note: Mixed-source approximation; potential overlap, seasonality and alignment with the simulator bbox require review.

inputs.label: Vehicles index
inputs.period: FY2020 Chennai numerator; 2026 Bangalore denominator as attributed
inputs.metric: Registered-vehicle count rescaled to Bangalore = 100
inputs.sourceTitle: Number of registered motor vehicles in Chennai (Statista / CEIC, FY2020)
inputs.derivation: Stored calculation: approximately 6 million / approximately 12 million × 100 = 50. Different-year inputs and denominator remain unverified.
inputs.note: Repository attribution only; source text, exact value, metric, period and geographic match have not been independently verified.

inputs.label: Population context

inputs.footprint: City proper claimed; exact geography unverified
